question: Which receiver and cover contacts allow the fitted Pisco cover to roll, and can short unsupported flat catches bear at both sides?

video.name: A_0001C014A261122_1902433A_CANON.MP4
video.method: Register the surrounding receiver texture between frames, then measure the lower edge and texture on the rigid cover. Fit a circle to the visible rim of the white outlet for translation. Paired views have a common orientation and magnification.
video.unit: Projected image-plane angle relative to the fixed receiver. The rim is circular, so it does not report rotation of the regulator. Hand force and hidden contacts are unmeasured.
testimony: two-diamond is better than what we had - still basically the same behavior of rocking, but slightly less so.
one-diamond is hard to tell the difference from the original.

three-diamond is the only one that exhibits different behavior, shifting from one firm position to another. It is as if the wings are too short in Z for both wing tip ribs to stay at the right Z to be implanted fully.
video.interpretation: The third cover repeatedly settles at two different angles while the outlet stays near its center. Alternating load between opposite hooks and a rounded regulator acting as a pivot are consistent with the picture. A tip touching the roof and a hook riding its chamfer remain physically distinguishable causes.

bridge_baselines.observations: Each solid-post bridge formed. Derek rejected the finish under the roofs. The neighboring bridges on fins collapsed.
Derek called the completed R roofs pretty good and preferred R125. No quantitative sag or snap-fit measurement was made.
The long ASSE catch sagged into the opening. Sagging courses were also visible on the neighboring Pisco catch.
Earlier square Pisco catches printed with removable support passed Derek's fit check.

comparison: C and D have equal total open length per side on permanent lands. D has fewer tooth lead-ins and more actual horizontal tooth bearing area. The comparison changes both the distribution and area of contact.
